title: Semilinear Galois actions on commutative Hopf algebras
statement: Let $k$ and $L$ be fields [def-weil-field] and $L$ a $k$-algebra [def-pc-field-extension]. Put $\Pi=\operatorname{Aut}_k(L)$. Let $B$ be a commutative Hopf $L$-algebra with comultiplication $\Delta$, counit $\epsilon$ and antipode $S$ satisfying the identities in [lem-sfb-affine-group-coordinate-hopf], and tensor products as in [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. A semilinear Hopf action is a group homomorphism $\rho:\Pi\to\operatorname{Aut}_{\mathrm{ring}}(B)$ such that $\rho_\sigma(\lambda b)=\sigma(\lambda)\rho_\sigma(b)$, $\rho_\sigma S=S\rho_\sigma$, $\epsilon\rho_\sigma=\sigma\epsilon$, and $\Delta\rho_\sigma=(\rho_\sigma\otimes\rho_\sigma)\Delta$, where the last tensor map is the diagonal $\sigma$-semilinear map. The category of these objects has $L$-linear Hopf homomorphisms commuting with $\rho$ as morphisms, with ordinary identities and composition. Its invariant algebra is the $k$-subalgebra $B^\Pi=\{b\in B\mid \rho_\sigma(b)=b\text{ for all }\sigma\in\Pi\}$, with inherited ring operations and the scalar structure restricted along $k\to L$.
